cards.title: A showroom at /demos
cards.text: A rail of every demo, each on a stage in its own colour; the start features the guesthouse.

cards.title: Seemeeu Guesthouse
cards.text: Shows the garden room for a dog, then sends the booking only after a yes.

cards.title: Wheatfield Kitchen
cards.text: Answers at ten at night, never promises a table, takes the request.

cards.title: Koringland Attorneys
cards.text: Gives no legal advice; offers a first consultation, one question at a time.

cards.title: Recorded once, played back
cards.text: Real answers on the site's own model; only the timing is played back.

cards.title: Then tried live
cards.text: After the last turn the same window becomes a live chat with that business.
